title: 塔吉克-波斯语跨脚本低资源NLP词汇资源与混合模型
summary: 介绍TajPersLexon，一个包含40,112对词和短语的塔吉克-波斯语平行词汇资源，用于低资源场景下的跨脚本词汇检索、音译和对齐。CPU基准测试表明，神经和检索方法达到98-99%的top-1准确率，而可解释的混合模型在OCR后校正任务中实现96.4%准确率，兼顾精度与效率。
summary_en: Introduces TajPersLexon, a Tajik-Persian parallel lexical resource of 40,112 pairs for cross-script lexical retrieval, transliteration, and alignment in low-resource settings. CPU benchmarks show neural and retrieval methods achieve 98-99% top-1 accuracy, while an interpretable hybrid model offers 96.4% accuracy in OCR post-correction with favorable efficiency.
